name: Silk the Pinstripe Cat
blurb: Silk, a sleek silver tabby with hair-thin charcoal pinstripes and a white chin, slips between the fence rails so neatly she never bends a leaf.

name: Hush the Quiet Grey Cat
blurb: Hush, a smooth blue-grey shorthair with pale gold eyes, sits so still in the lavender that you forget she is there until she blinks at you.

name: Lilac the Sunstone Cat
blurb: Lilac, a cream cat with pinkish-grey ears, face and paws, recharges with a nap on a warm round stepping stone, then wakes up ready to chase moths.
